description: This file declares the BasicSourceLineResolver class, which implements source line resolution functionality for debugging symbols, along with helper functions for parsing Breakpad symbol files. It defines class interfaces, parsing helpers, and includes licensing information.

classes.name: BasicSourceLineResolver
classes.description: Implements source line resolution using address map files, derived from SourceLineResolverBase.

classes.name: SymbolParseHelper
classes.description: Provides static methods for parsing Breakpad symbol files, such as FILE, FUNC, line, and PUBLIC declarations.

methods.name: ParseFile
methods.description: Parses a FILE declaration line, extracting file id and filename.

methods.name: ParseFunction
methods.description: Parses a FUNC declaration line, extracting address, size, stack param size, and function name.

methods.name: ParseLine
methods.description: Parses a line declaration, extracting address, size, line number, and source file id.

methods.name: ParsePublicSymbol
methods.description: Parses a PUBLIC declaration, extracting address, stack param size, and symbol name.

methods.name: IsValidAfterNumber
methods.description: Checks if the string after a number is valid for parsing.
